title: Credit Builder Accounts Made-Good Relief on Returned-Payment Fees
content:
## The relief

A returned-payment fee relief is granted without a request once its returned payment has been made good, is booked as a courtesy waiver that counts toward the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months, and is granted only while fewer than that number have been granted on the account; a goodwill credit on a late fee and the early-closure late-fee and returned-fee reliefs each follow their own rule, and any other courtesy waiver is still granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the account.

Being granted without a request, the made-good relief is not held to the fee waiver request window, whatever the fee's age, and the early-closure late-fee relief and the early-closure returned-fee relief are likewise governed by their own rules; every other courtesy waiver must still be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.

The made-good relief is not figured until the account's most recent returned payment, when its return code carries a fee, shows its returned-payment fee on the account, unless that fee comes to 0.00.

While the account has a pending early-closure request, the early-closure returned-fee relief takes priority over this relief on the same fee, and the made-good relief is not granted.

| Credit Builder account facts | Made-good relief |
|---|---|
| the most recent returned payment has been made good, its fee is unpaid, courtesy waivers remain within the plan's number | granted, with no request and whatever the fee's age |
| an early-closure request pending confirmation on the account | not granted |
| the plan's courtesy waivers all granted in the 12 months | not granted |

## Booking the relief: `relieve_returned_payment_fee_d8e21ef6`

**What it does.** The tool grants relief on one returned-payment fee of a Credit Builder account. It books a fee waiver entry with the courtesy basis, dated today and linked to the returned-payment fee it relieves, and lowers the account's unpaid fees by the relief. The borrower sees the relief and the lower unpaid-fee balance on the account.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `relieve_returned_payment_fee_d8e21ef6` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `builder_account_id` | reference number of the Credit Builder account, as returned by the Credit Builder account lookup |
| `related_txn_id` | reference number of the returned-payment fee entry being relieved, as listed among the account's entries by the Credit Builder entry lookup |
| `relief_amount` | the relief in USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Relief <entry reference> of <amount> USD booked on <account reference> against fee <entry reference>; unpaid fees now <amount> USD.", where amounts are in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving this text means the relief is on the account.
